kibana.query:
TS metrics-node.prometheus-default
| WHERE (?node == "" OR (labels.instance RLIKE ?node OR (labels.instance IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?node)))
| WHERE (?job == "" OR (labels.job RLIKE ?job OR (labels.job IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?job)))
| WHERE metrics.node_vmstat_pgpgin IS NOT NULL OR metrics.node_vmstat_pgpgout IS NOT NULL
| STATS Pagesin_Page_in_operations = AVG(IRATE(metrics.node_vmstat_pgpgin)), node_vmstat_pgpgout_B = AVG(IRATE(metrics.node_vmstat_pgpgout)) BY time_bucket = TBUCKET(100, ?_tstart, ?_tend), labels.instance, labels.job
| EVAL Pagesout_Page_out_operations = (-1 * node_vmstat_pgpgout_B)
| DROP node_vmstat_pgpgout_B
| SORT time_bucket ASC

TS metrics-node.prometheus-default
| WHERE (?node == "" OR (labels.instance RLIKE ?node OR (labels.instance IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?node)))
| WHERE (?job == "" OR (labels.job RLIKE ?job OR (labels.job IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?job)))
| WHERE metrics.node_vmstat_pswpin IS NOT NULL OR metrics.node_vmstat_pswpout IS NOT NULL
| STATS Pswpin_Pages_swapped_in = AVG(IRATE(metrics.node_vmstat_pswpin)), node_vmstat_pswpout_B = AVG(IRATE(metrics.node_vmstat_pswpout)) BY time_bucket = TBUCKET(100, ?_tstart, ?_tend), labels.instance, labels.job
| EVAL Pswpout_Pages_swapped_out = (-1 * node_vmstat_pswpout_B)
| DROP node_vmstat_pswpout_B
| SORT time_bucket ASC

title: Memory Page Faults

legends: Pgfault - Page major and minor fault operations

kibana.query:
TS metrics-node.prometheus-default
| WHERE (?node == "" OR (labels.instance RLIKE ?node OR (labels.instance IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?node)))
| WHERE (?job == "" OR (labels.job RLIKE ?job OR (labels.job IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?job)))
| WHERE metrics.node_vmstat_pgfault IS NOT NULL OR metrics.node_vmstat_pgmajfault IS NOT NULL
| STATS Pgfault_Page_major_and_minor_fault_operations = AVG(IRATE(metrics.node_vmstat_pgfault)), Pgmajfault_Major_page_fault_operations = AVG(IRATE(metrics.node_vmstat_pgmajfault)) BY time_bucket = TBUCKET(100, ?_tstart, ?_tend), labels.instance, labels.job
| EVAL Pgminfault_Minor_page_fault_operations = (Pgfault_Page_major_and_minor_fault_operations - Pgmajfault_Major_page_fault_operations)
| SORT time_bucket ASC

note: Pgfault is stack:false overlay on line_1 datasource layer; first-layer-only metric count undercounted (2 vs 3).
